853:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Giving me the cold shoulder again, as usual? But for Mr. $$キリコ$$'s sake, I brewed some coffee with a special stash of beans.」

853:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Otherwise, next time I'll want a reaction, and I'll end up mixing in all sorts of foreign objects.」

853:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... what a great reaction... even if my life is hanging by a thread...」

853:t_11:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Miss $$テイタニア$$!」

853:t_11:4.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「How strange... These are the words of a phony robot, yet they make me far happier than the Pope's blessing.」

853:t_11:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's because I am a being who has surpassed God.」

853:t_11:6.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「That I can laugh even at such a worthless quip must be because of the free air I never had when I was in the Church.」

853:t_11:7.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$フィアナ$$... Because you pushed me forward, I was able to gain so many things...)

853:t_11:8.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I want to send you and $$キリコ$$ my boundless gratitude...)

853:t_11:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um, hellooo... Have you forgotten about me...?」

853:t_12:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$シャッコ$$!」

853:t_12:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, those eyes...! Gazing through to the inside of my armor like that is an invasion of privacy!?」

853:t_12:6.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「To think the word 'privacy' would come out of your mouth...」

853:t_12:7.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Never mind... I've been a bit out of shape lately, so you'll join me for training.」

853:t_12:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, no way! Put me down, Mr. $$シャッコ$$! Gently, softly, like a feather!」

853:t_12:10.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「That depends on you from here on...! Don't betray my trust, $$ＡＧ$$!」

853:t_13:6.en:
$$桂$$
「Remembering to be considerate to the girl, too. You're pretty good, $$ＡＧ$$.」

853:t_13:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Being praised by Mr. $$桂$$ fills me with gratitude and deepest honor.」

853:t_13:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that regard, I would like Mr. $$桂$$ to teach me his secrets for grasping the female psyche...」

853:t_13:9.en:
$$桂$$
「Don't be so stiff. If you're that rigid, you won't get anywhere hitting on girls.」

853:t_13:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, I see... Fine then, $$桂$$... I'll just call you by your bare name.」

853:t_13:12.en:
$$モーム$$
「Hey, $$ＡＧ$$! Don't call my $$桂$$ by his bare name!」

853:t_13:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yeah, yeah. Following Miss $$モーム$$'s lead, I'll keep addressing Mr. $$桂$$ with the title from now on.」

853:t_14:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$カミーユ$$!」

853:t_14:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have heard Mr. $$カミーユ$$'s tales of valor several times already, but...」

853:t_14:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This time, I would like to hear about 'correction.'」

853:t_14:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Correction... you mean when a superior officer in the military dishes out corporal punishment to a subordinate?」

853:t_14:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I want to hear lines like 'I'll correct adults like that!!'...」

853:t_14:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Come on... Do you think there are any adults who'd get that kind of treatment from $c?」

853:t_14:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is that really so? Clinging to the past, using a false name, and grumbling on and on about cactus flowers...」

853:t_14:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't know about correction, but there might be a junk robot around that needs repair.」

853:t_15:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so obviously on guard around me!」

853:t_15:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. It is all due to this $$ＡＧ$$'s lack of virtue.」

853:t_15:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, I shall inflict damage on this body and make amends...」

853:t_15:9.en:
$$ファ$$
「Y-you don't have to go that far...!」

853:t_15:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Awww... I thought that if I couldn't move anymore, Miss $$ファ$$ would give me full nursing care~」

853:t_15:11.en:
$$ファ$$
「Don't push your luck! If that happened, I'd ask $$アストナージ$$ to turn you into scrap!」

853:t_15:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This treatment... a world of difference from when it's Mr. $$カミーユ$$...」

853:t_15:13.en:
$$ファ$$
「Huh...? Do you mean $$カミーユ$$ is going to get hurt...!?」

853:t_15:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-well... I'm only talking about a possibility, though...」

853:t_16:4.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Will you treat me to something?」

853:t_16:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If Miss $$フォウ$$ is the one, then this $$ＡＧ$$... would empty even the safe of the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ for you!」

853:t_16:6.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I'm happy... Being somebody's number one like this doesn't happen to me much.」

853:t_16:7.en:
$$フォウ$$
「With a name like mine, of course it doesn't. Can't be helped...」

853:t_16:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then what was all that act until just now!?」

853:t_17:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so obviously on guard around me!」

853:t_17:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You are so kind about the bodily functions of young boys, yet you discriminate against me so blatantly just because I'm a robot...」

853:t_17:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or is it that, since you have a steady partner, you intend to shut out the likes of me...」

853:t_17:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, how far has your relationship with Captain $$ヘンケン$$ actually progressed?」

853:t_17:10.en:
$$エマ$$
「It's because you do things like that that people are wary of you! Understand that!」

853:t_18:4.en:
$$カツ$$
「So I'm an ace pilot at last. I wonder if this brings me a little closer to Captain $$アムロ$$.」

853:t_18:6.en:
$$カツ$$
「Don't tell me I'll get hit by a meteorite. You've warned me about it so many times that even I've become wary of it.」
